types.label: Watch a folder
types.description: Starts a run for each new file that appears in one folder, once its size and time have stopped changing. The files already there the first time it starts are left alone. A file that changes after it was passed on, or is renamed, is passed on again as a new file.

folder.title: Folder
folder.description: The folder to watch. Folders inside it are not watched.

settle_ms.title: Wait until quiet (ms)
settle_ms.description: A file is passed on once its size and time have not changed for this long. A write that pauses for longer than this is passed on twice: at the pause, and again once it is whole.
